scope: Equation-derived good reduction on one tame cover at eleven, and information loss after forgetting descent and filtration. No full named-source ablation or eta equation is asserted.
deduction_boundary: The unfiltered rational Frobenius modules are isomorphic by a written cyclic-basis proof; p-adic cohomology is not mechanized. Inertia descent, Hodge filtration, integral structures, global rank and normalized GZ data are not frozen by this lens. A nonzero beta from the cover cannot specialize equivariantly to the original classical U11=0 line, even as a generalized eigenvector. An independent additive modular comparison and all eta normalization inputs remain open.
